title: Review: fix: use senderId field name in kithctl watch notification
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — The functional fix is correct and complete. The only risk is a weak regression test that won't catch future field renames in kith-core.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: no end-to-end integration test that spins up kithd, delivers a message via Peer/deliver, and then checks that kithctl watch fires a notification with the correct sender — the only integration coverage is unit-level. Would raise confidence if: there were an integration test exercising the full SSE → Message/get → notification path against a real kithd instance.
